title: GameStop stock sinks after eBay rejects takeover bid
title_zh: eBay 拒绝收购要约后 GameStop 股价下跌
summary: GameStop stock drops after eBay rejects the retailer's takeover bid.
summary_zh: eBay 拒绝零售商的收购要约后，GameStop 股价下跌。

title: Why AMD's AI roadmap is 'very competitive' with Nvidia's
title_zh: 为什么 AMD 的 AI 路线图与 Nvidia 的“非常有竞争力”
summary: Benchmark Company managing director and senior semiconductor research analyst Cody Acree joins Yahoo Finance to explain where AMD (AMD) stands in relation to Nvidia (NVDA), and what to expect from Nvidia's upcoming earnings results.
summary_zh: Benchmark Company 董事总经理兼高级半导体研究分析师 Cody Acree 与雅虎财经一起解释 AMD (AMD) 相对于 Nvidia (NVDA) 的地位，以及对 Nvidia 即将发布的盈利结果的预期。

title: Tesla’s robotaxi rollout features Texas-sized wait times
title_zh: 特斯拉推出的机器人出租车的等待时间与德克萨斯州相当
summary: When Tesla announced an expansion of its robotaxis to Dallas and Houston last month, some investors touted momentum for CEO Elon Musk’s mission to transform the electric-vehicle maker into an AI-powered, driverless-tech giant.
summary_zh: 当特斯拉上个月宣布将其机器人出租车扩展到达拉斯和休斯顿时，一些投资者称赞首席执行官埃隆·马斯克将电动汽车制造商转变为人工智能驱动的无人驾驶技术巨头的使命的动力。

title: TikTok challenges EU 'gatekeeper' status at Europe's top court
title_zh: TikTok 在欧洲最高法院挑战欧盟“看门人”地位
summary: Bytedance's social media platform TikTok on Tuesday made a last- ditch attempt at Europe's top court to scrap its ‌designation as a "gatekeeper" under EU rules, which require it to meet tougher standards ‌as regulators seek to curb the power of Big Tech.
summary_zh: 周二，字节跳动旗下社交媒体平台 TikTok 在欧洲最高法院做出了最后一搏，试图取消其在欧盟规则下的“看门人”称号，该规则要求其满足更严格的标准，因为监管机构试图遏制大型科技公司的力量。

title: Korea Roils Market by Floating ‘Citizen Dividend’ From AI
title_zh: 韩国通过人工智能带来的“公民红利”搅动市场
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A top South Korean policymaker said the nation should pay citizens a “dividend” using taxes on AI profits, underscoring growing pressure to redistribute gains from a boom that’s enriched chipmakers like Samsung Electronics Co.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——韩国一位高级政策制定者表示，国家应该通过对人工智能利润征税来向公民支付“红利”，这突显出重新分配繁荣带来的收益的压力越来越大，而繁荣让三星电子等芯片制造商变得富有。

title: Meta loses court fight over compensation to Italian publishers
title_zh: Meta 在向意大利出版商赔偿的诉讼中败诉
summary: Meta Platforms on Tuesday lost its fight against an Italian regulatory order that it should ‌compensate publishers for using snippets of their news articles after Europe's ‌top court sided with the Italian telecoms watchdog.
summary_zh: 周二，在欧洲最高法院支持意大利电信监管机构之后，Meta Platforms 在反对意大利监管命令的斗争中败诉，该命令要求出版商对使用其新闻文章片段的行为进行赔偿。
